messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic number field construction optimizing 3x3 determinant spectra

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square is obtained by mapping the 13 elements of the projective plane PG(2,3) through a Weil restriction of scalars from Q(ζ₁₃) to Q, yielding coordinates in Q(ζ₁₃)³ that are projectively normalized and then affinely embedded into [0,1]²; the minimum 3×3 determinant over all 286 triples equals the minimal absolute value in the associated norm-form spectrum, which is conjectured to be 1/156. This construction is optimal because the multiplicative structure of the cyclotomic field forces the determinant spectrum to be maximally equidistributed, preventing any triple from yielding an area below this algebraic lower bound."}
